start: A member in a gym; the gym sent a 'Gym closed' message; the bell on the Gym tab shows 1

steps.action: Tap the bell on the Gym tab
user_sees: Screen 'Messages', subtitle 'From <gym name>'
A card: 'Gym closed', 'Just now' / '2 h ago', the title and the body
must_not: Another gym's message
A message the gym withdrew

steps.action: Come back to the Gym tab
user_sees: The bell's number gone
must_not: The number still 1 after the message was on screen

start: A member in a gym; a pop-up 'News from your gym' on the phone

user_sees: The 'Messages' screen opens (route /shop/inbox) with the new message at the top
must_not: An empty screen while the list loads
A pop-up for a quiet (3rd or later of the day) message

start: A member in a gym; the internet is off

steps.action: Open the bell, then pull down to refresh
user_sees: The last messages kept on the phone
'No internet — showing the last messages.'
must_not: An empty list that looks like 'No messages yet'
A crash

steps.action: A gym that never sent anything
user_sees: 'No messages yet' and 'When your gym sends news — a holiday, new timings, an offer — it shows here.'
must_not: A spinner that never ends

start: A member in a gym; two unseen messages, one seen while offline

steps.action: Open the bell offline, then go online later
user_sees: Both shown as seen on the phone at once
The gym is told again when the next refresh works
must_not: The bell number coming back after reopening
The gym never hearing the message was seen

user_sees: The messages go from the phone
must_not: The old gym's messages shown after joining another gym

start: A member in a gym; the gym sends a message to one group only

user_sees: Only messages sent to everyone or to this member's group
must_not: A message meant for another group
Another member's name or number in a message list
